description: This file defines an internal sealed class `SiloMetadataClient` that implements `ISiloMetadataClient`. It provides a method to asynchronously retrieve silo metadata given a silo address, utilizing a grain factory to interface with system targets.

classes.name: SiloMetadataClient
classes.description: Sealed internal class responsible for retrieving silo metadata asynchronously via system targets using a grain factory.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the silo metadata for a specified silo address.
